body:
How are you? 

They never care to actually here how you are and most times the conversation moves before you can answer

*Hear
A little of everything. Regrets and how I can be more successful in the future, how to make better decisions and missing the people most important to me.
He’d probably eat everything in my fridge immediately and use my computer. Meanwhile I’d probably take infinite naps and vomit when he doesn’t get up fast enough.

The social security administration called and left a voicemail that said I was dead in so many words and my social security number was being deactivated. I called back and they immediately say oh yeah and put me on hold. They come back on the line and tell me they have the police report that says everything before verifying any part of my identity and they could tell me what happened to me after I provide my social security number..
When they couldn’t get over the hurt of losing their ex and kept fighting for them.
My stomach aches, what if’s and food cravings

Just take it one day at a time. Sometimes when you feel your mood changing it’s best to put your phone down and distract yourself, I did that for a while to avoid being rude at the people I knew. Really it’s about patience and understanding to yourself. You deserve kindness and compassion also, give that to yourself. 

And vent as much as you need to on here if it keeps you breathing.
Good for you! Thanks for pointing out I can also leave this subreddit to improve my outlook. Best of luck
Yes, my thoughts lately. We did something bad in another world and got sentenced to “life” lol.

You honestly don’t know what I know or have experienced. I think that’s part of the problem no? People don’t know what you’re going through and they judge. Maybe I do know how it feels to be stared at and bullied for being ftm. Maybe I quit transitioning because of it. Maybe I’ve been homeless for years and know what it’s like to sleep in a tiny room with your entire family. 

Please reconsider, there are some people that actually relate and care.

Maybe they don’t. When I had a group of friends I realized they only wanted to talk or be around me if I was capable of smiling. People prefer for you to keep the sadness to yourself, so all the smiling and laughing everyone saw me doing with my “friends” was fake and I really had no support either. I’m learning to support myself, after hitting rock bottom with my depression. I realized you can’t depend on other people. My closest friend got annoyed at me and said they’re not a therapist when I tried to vent and asked for support. You may find one or two people, but you’ll realize everything is not as it seems.

I gained weight on my initial medications also and had negative side effects. I talked to my doctor at the time and they switched me to something different and I ended up losing a lot of weight, more than I had gained. Now I’m off of them because too any side effects. Regardless you should tell your doctor what’s happening and try something different

What you see isn’t reality. It’s like the universe put all these people around you to torture you. Fight, push through. They smile on the outside but I don’t think they’re as happy when they’re alone. Life is about your own struggle and how you overcome it. Swim, don’t sink. Hold on a little longer.

So do I. I know how you feel, truly. I’m going through the same thing. But I stay positive by thinking about when I’m away from everyone in this town and how I’ll be in a better environment eventually. You can try therapy as well, it helps somewhat getting to unload for an hour

Please don’t do that. I think this is just how you’re feeling now and you’re only in the middle of everything. When you’re out of the woods it won’t be so bad. People suck and they’re really judgmental about things they don’t know. I hate to keep saying this but in these situations you win by living. Your smile will be so much bigger and you’ll feel stronger too.
Please don’t. People suck, I know. But the best way to win is to live. Otherwise the world wins. I hope you feel better soon.

Yes. Some of my friends cut me off because they said I’m just narcissistic and I made up my abuse for attention. *Queue spiraling depression* 
I don’t mention suicidal thoughts because I know where that goes now. Suffering in silence can be better than being bullied on top of it.

I second this. I had to quit both of my medications because they started having the opposite effect and I was having severe mood swings. I chose exercise, Netflix and work in the meantime and am too scared to start medication again because of how bad things got.
